title: Knotted Crumbly British Bread Cottage Pie
description: A traditional British dish featuring stale bread and a crumbly texture, perfect for a low-sodium friendly meal. This cottage pie is a hearty and comforting option for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, cook the ground beef over medium heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and carrot to the pan and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the peas, tomato paste, and beef broth, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
In a large bowl, tear the stale bread into small pieces and mix with the cooked beef mixture until well combined.
Transfer the bread mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and dot the top with butter.
In a small bowl, beat the egg and brush it over the top of the bread mixture to help it brown in the oven.
Bake the cottage pie in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
